title: KDE Celebrates 30th Anniversary with Plasma 6.8 Release
excerpt: KDE marks its 30th anniversary by launching Plasma 6.8, introducing remote upgrades, an accompanying movie, and saying goodbye to X11.
body_html:
The KDE project is marking its 30th anniversary with the rollout of Plasma 6.8. This latest software milestone brings several updates to the platform, including the addition of remote upgrades.

Alongside the technical updates, the anniversary celebration includes the release of a movie dedicated to the project.

Notably, the new release also includes a final farewell to X11, moving the software further forward in its development path.
